field_notes.below_fold_controls_normal_scroll: Original R5/R4 objective field; preserve separately from horizontal overflow and clipping.
field_notes.body_horizontal_overflow: Original body-overflow boolean; preserve with body_overflow_px and dimensions.
field_notes.clipped_controls: Original count; exact element/ancestor facts are in geometry rows/elements.
field_notes.document_horizontal_overflow: Original document-overflow boolean; preserve with document_overflow_px and dimensions.
field_notes.duplicate_accessible_names: Original count; exact groups preserve name and item descriptors.
field_notes.empty_accessible_names: Original count; exact descriptors preserve tag, role, selector, classes, ariaLabel/name/title/alt.
field_notes.fixed_sticky_main_overlap: Original count; exact participants/intersection rectangles are in geometry rows/elements.
field_notes.material_ready_failure: Original R5 metric; readiness fields are preserved separately and are not a severity or final-readiness verdict.
field_notes.out_of_viewport_controls: Original count; target_geometry preserves original target field and element rectangles.

claim_boundary: Text-only VERIFY evidence normalization. Immutable R4/R5/R6 facts are preserved for independent audit; no severity, P0/P1/P2 classification, visual-quality verdict, human acceptance, stable/production claim, CHG-59 qualification, Product-defect or FIX decision.
